description: This header file defines the API for managing IP diagnostics trace route operations in a TR-069 device, including getter and setter functions for various trace route parameters, as well as related documentation and macro definitions.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Getter for the 'DiagnosticsState' parameter indicating diagnostic data availability status.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Interface
methods.description: Getter for the source IP interface for the trace route test.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Host
methods.description: Getter for the hostname or address of the target host for trace route.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_NumberOfTries
methods.description: Getter for the number of tries per hop for the trace route.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Timeout
methods.description: Getter for the timeout in milliseconds for each hop.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DataBlockSize
methods.description: Getter for the size in bytes of the data block sent per trace route.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DSCP
methods.description: Getter for the DSCP value used for test packets.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_MaxHopCount
methods.description: Getter for the maximum number of hops (max TTL).

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_ResponseTime
methods.description: Getter for the response time of the most recent trace route test.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHopsNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Getter for the number of route hops entries.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Setter for the 'DiagnosticsState' parameter, initiates the trace route test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Interface
methods.description: Setter for the source IP interface.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Host
methods.description: Setter for the target host name or address.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_NumberOfTries
methods.description: Setter for the number of tries per hop.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Timeout
methods.description: Setter for the hop timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DataBlockSize
methods.description: Setter for the data block size in bytes.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_MaxHopCount
methods.description: Setter for the maximum number of hops.
